items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: And I asked that sort of question to Rashied Ali and he answered

ctx.x: know, so I gave him that. I mean I guess the next time I saw Dexter was like when the Art Ensemble went to Europe, so he was there in Copenhagen.

I want to ask you about that but sometimes I get this vision in my head when I hear music that is sort of breaking boundaries. I picture gentlemen like yourselves when you were younger sitting around in a late night diner talking about what we could do to make the music different. And I asked that sort of question to Rashied Ali and he answered, “No we never really talked about it we just did it. The guys I was hanging out with we didn’t sit down and say now we’re going to play in or we’re going to play out or no…

Well not really. I mean you know because stepping over to Muhal’s arena you know, you’re working man. You’re working. You’re being encouraged. You know if you bring a piece in and you’re having some problems with it you were encouraged to go home and change whatever you wanted to do and bring your piece back because Muhal used to always say, you know, “You need to get it right you know, because if you don’t every time you listen to it you’re going to hear an unfinished part there” so like I’m saying you were…
